profile_text.body:
LinkedIn describes itself as a professional network with 1 billion members, where people manage their professional identity, build and engage with their professional network, and access knowledge, insights and opportunities. Its site highlights features including Open To Work, which lets members privately tell recruiters or publicly share with the LinkedIn community that they are looking for new job opportunities, direct messaging to strengthen relationships, and formats such as live videos, stories and newsletters for following discussions in an industry. The company is recorded as for-profit, founded in 2003, and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, United States.

On the AI side, the material is thin. No products are tracked for LinkedIn, and the only AI-related item held is an MCP server listed as ai.com.mcp/linkedin, described as exposing the LinkedIn API as MCP tools to retrieve profile data and publish content, powered by HAPI MCP.

The remaining held facts concern legal exposure. LinkedIn is recorded with 281 California law exposure entries and no cases.
